newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were quietky steady in moderate trade with most traders sidelined due mainly to an absence of fresh incentives, dealers said on Friday.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning on lack of fresh factors. There's no fresh news or (U.S.) economic indicators coming out tonight and most people have squared their positions for the weekend," a local dealer said.
"But some people are waiting for Monday's release of the (U.S. April) retail sales data, for fresh clues to market direction," he said.
In day-to-day rates, weekend slipped 1/8 percentage point to 5-1/2 5-3/8 percent and Monday/Tuesday eased 1/16 point to 5-9/16 5-7/16 percent.
Week-fixed was unchanged from Thursday's 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent.
Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged at 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent, three-month unchanged at 5-13/16 5-11/16, nine-months unchanged at 6-1/8 6 and twelve-months unchanged at 6-5/16 6-3/16 percent.
